sentences.en: There is a cat on my balcony.
sentences.slip: That is a cat on my balcony.
sentences.note: There is = «есть, находится». That is = «вон то — это…».

sentences.en: That is my neighbour's cat.
sentences.slip: There is my neighbour's cat.
sentences.note: Показываешь на конкретного кота — That is. Сообщаешь о наличии — There is.

sentences.en: There are four coffee shops near my house.
sentences.prompt: ____ four coffee shops near my house.
sentences.slip: There is four coffee shops near my house.
sentences.note: Дальше идёт множественное число — There ARE.

sentences.en: This is my new microphone.
sentences.slip: There is my new microphone.
sentences.note: This is — про то, что у тебя в руках. That is — про то, что вон там.

sentences.en: Put the coffee over there, please.
sentences.note: there = «там, туда» (место). that = «то, тот» (предмет).

sentences.en: I know that you edit videos at night.
sentences.ru: Я знаю, что ты монтируешь ночью.
sentences.prompt: I know ____ you edit videos at night.
sentences.slip: I know there you edit videos at night.
sentences.note: that = «что» — союз, соединяет две части предложения.

sentences.en: There isn't any milk in the fridge.
sentences.slip: There no milk in the fridge.
sentences.note: Нет чего-то → There isn't. Milk неисчисляемое, поэтому isn't.

sentences.en: These headphones are too loud.
sentences.slip: This headphones are too loud.
sentences.note: headphones всегда множественное — These/Those, не This/That.

sentences.en: Those clouds over the sea look heavy.
sentences.ru: Вон те облака над морем тяжёлые.
sentences.prompt: ____ clouds over the sea look heavy.
sentences.note: Далеко и много → Those. Близко и много → These.

sentences.en: Is there a pharmacy near the beach?
sentences.slip: There is a pharmacy near the beach?
sentences.note: Вопрос: is меняется местами с there — «Is there…?»

sentences.en: There was a big storm in Limassol last night.
sentences.ru: Ночью в Лимасоле был сильный шторм.
sentences.prompt: ____ a big storm in Limassol last night.
sentences.note: Прошедшее время от There is — There was.

sentences.en: There were too many people at the beach.
sentences.ru: На пляже было слишком много людей.
sentences.prompt: ____ too many people at the beach.
sentences.slip: There was too many people at the beach.
sentences.note: People — множественное, значит There WERE.

sentences.en: That's why I don't drink coffee after six.
sentences.ru: Вот почему я не пью кофе после шести.
sentences.prompt: ____ why I don't drink coffee after six.
sentences.note: «That's why» — устойчивое «вот почему». There's why не говорят.

sentences.en: Look at this — my video got 200 000 views.
sentences.prompt: Look at ____ — my video got 200 000 views.
sentences.note: Показываешь на свой экран, это рядом — this.

sentences.en: Is that your car in front of the gate?
sentences.prompt: ____ your car in front of the gate?
sentences.note: Машина не у тебя в руках, она вон там — that.

sentences.en: There's no signal in the mountains.
sentences.note: There's = there is. Формы «this's» в английском не существует.

sentences.en: I want that one, not this one.
sentences.ru: Я хочу вон тот, а не этот.
sentences.prompt: I want ____ one, not this one.
sentences.note: That one — вон тот. This one — этот.

sentences.en: Are there any good sushi places in Paphos?
sentences.prompt: ____ any good sushi places in Paphos?
sentences.slip: There are any good sushi places in Paphos?
sentences.note: Вопрос во множественном числе — Are there…?

sentences.en: This is the best espresso in the neighbourhood.
sentences.prompt: ____ is the best espresso in the neighbourhood.
sentences.note: Один эспрессо, он перед тобой — This is.

sentences.en: Alina left her keys over there, on the table.
sentences.ru: Алина оставила ключи вон там, на столе.
sentences.prompt: Alina left her keys over ____, on the table.
sentences.slip: Alina left her keys over that, on the table.
sentences.note: over there = «вон там». Это место, а не предмет.

sentences.en: I go to a restaurant every Friday.
sentences.ru: Я хожу в ресторан каждую пятницу.
sentences.prompt: I go to ____ restaurant every Friday.
sentences.slip: I go to restaurant every Friday.
sentences.note: Любой ресторан, не конкретный → a. Без артикля нельзя.

sentences.en: I work in a small studio at home.
sentences.ru: Я работаю в маленькой студии дома.
sentences.prompt: I work in ____ small studio at home.
sentences.slip: I work in small studio at home.
sentences.note: in a studio, in a school, in a hospital — везде артикль.

sentences.en: I am a video editor.
sentences.slip: I am video editor.
sentences.note: Профессия всегда с артиклем: I am a doctor, a teacher, an editor.

sentences.en: She is an English teacher.
sentences.slip: She is a English teacher.
sentences.note: Следующее слово English начинается с гласного звука → an.

sentences.en: Can you pass me the salt?
sentences.note: Соль на столе одна, обоим понятно какая → the.

sentences.en: I bought a new camera yesterday.
sentences.note: Первое упоминание — a. Дальше про неё же будет the.

sentences.en: The camera I bought yesterday is broken.
sentences.ru: Камера, которую я вчера купил, сломалась.
sentences.prompt: ____ camera I bought yesterday is broken.
sentences.note: Уже понятно, о какой камере речь → the.

sentences.en: I drink coffee every morning.
sentences.slip: I drink a coffee every morning.
sentences.note: Кофе вообще, как вещество — без артикля. «A coffee» = одна чашка.

sentences.en: I need an hour to finish the edit.
sentences.ru: Мне нужен час, чтобы доделать монтаж.
sentences.prompt: I need ____ hour to finish the edit.
sentences.slip: I need a hour to finish the edit.
sentences.note: В hour буква h не читается, слышно «ауэр» → an.

sentences.en: We live in Cyprus.
sentences.slip: We live in the Cyprus.
sentences.note: Перед названиями стран артикль не ставят: in Cyprus, in Russia.

sentences.en: This is the best coffee in town.
sentences.prompt: This is ____ best coffee in town.
sentences.slip: This is best coffee in town.
sentences.note: Превосходная степень (best, biggest) всегда с the.

sentences.en: He is a police officer.
sentences.slip: He is police officer.
sentences.note: Ровно та ошибка с урока 21 сентября: артикль обязателен.

sentences.en: I watch YouTube in the evening.
sentences.prompt: I watch ____ YouTube in the evening.
sentences.slip: I watch the YouTube in the evening.
sentences.note: Названия сервисов идут без артикля: YouTube, Instagram, Telegram.

sentences.en: There is a problem with my microphone.
sentences.prompt: There is ____ problem with my microphone.
sentences.slip: There is problem with my microphone.
sentences.note: Одна проблема, впервые упоминается → a problem.

sentences.en: Alina is an artist.
sentences.slip: Alina is a artist.
sentences.note: artist начинается с гласного звука → an.

sentences.en: I usually go to the gym after work.
sentences.ru: Обычно я хожу в зал после работы.
sentences.prompt: I usually go to ____ gym after work.
sentences.note: Тот самый зал, куда ходишь всегда → the gym.

sentences.en: I am tired after the long edit.
sentences.prompt: I ____ tired after the long edit.
sentences.slip: I tired after the long edit.
sentences.note: Перед состоянием нужен глагол: I am tired, не «I tired».

sentences.en: It will be sunny tomorrow.
sentences.slip: It will sunny tomorrow.
sentences.note: Твоя ошибка с урока: перед прилагательным нужен be — will BE sunny.

sentences.en: Alina and I are in Limassol today.
sentences.ru: Мы с Алиной сегодня в Лимасоле.
sentences.prompt: Alina and I ____ in Limassol today.
sentences.slip: Alina and I is in Limassol today.
sentences.note: X and I = we, а we всегда с are.

sentences.en: My laptop is very slow today.
sentences.slip: My laptop very slow today.
sentences.note: Одна вещь → is. И выбрасывать его нельзя.

sentences.en: The videos are ready for upload.
sentences.slip: The videos is ready for upload.
sentences.note: Videos — множественное число → are.

sentences.en: I am not a beginner, I have eight years of experience.
sentences.ru: Я не новичок, у меня восемь лет опыта.
sentences.prompt: I ____ a beginner, I have eight years of experience.
sentences.slip: I not a beginner, I have eight years of experience.
sentences.note: Отрицание с to be: am + not. Do здесь не нужен.

sentences.en: This coffee is too hot to drink.
sentences.prompt: This coffee ____ too hot to drink.
sentences.note: Coffee — одна порция → is.

sentences.en: You are right about the sound.
sentences.slip: You right about the sound.
sentences.note: You всегда с are, даже если это один человек.

sentences.en: The weather in Cyprus is hot in September.
sentences.prompt: The weather in Cyprus ____ hot in September.
sentences.note: Weather — единственное число, всегда is.

sentences.en: We are happy with the new apartment.
sentences.prompt: We ____ happy with the new apartment.
sentences.slip: We happy with the new apartment.
sentences.note: We + are. Без связки фраза разваливается.

sentences.en: My headphones are broken again.
sentences.slip: My headphones is broken again.
sentences.note: Headphones — всегда множественное число.

sentences.en: He is not at home right now.
sentences.prompt: He ____ not at home right now.
sentences.slip: He don't at home right now.
sentences.note: С to be отрицание делается через not, а не через don't.

sentences.en: I don't understand this word.
sentences.slip: I'm not understand this word.
sentences.note: Твоя ошибка с урока: «I'm not understand» — нельзя. Нужно I don't understand.

sentences.en: My translator doesn't know this word.
sentences.ru: Мой переводчик не знает это слово.
sentences.slip: My translator not know this word.
sentences.note: Ещё одна ошибка урока: он/она/оно → doesn't.

sentences.en: Do you want coffee or tea?
sentences.note: Вопрос про you → Do you…?

sentences.en: Does Alina work on Saturdays?
sentences.slip: Do Alina work on Saturdays?
sentences.note: Alina = she → Does. И глагол после does без -s.

sentences.en: We don't have meetings on Friday.
sentences.ru: У нас нет созвонов по пятницам.
sentences.note: We → don't.

sentences.en: He doesn't like horror movies.
sentences.slip: He don't like horror movies.
sentences.note: He/she/it → doesn't, и глагол остаётся без -s: doesn't like.

sentences.en: What time do you usually wake up?
sentences.prompt: What time ____ you usually wake up?
sentences.note: Вопросительное слово + do + you + глагол.

sentences.en: Do they speak English at home?
sentences.note: They → Do.

sentences.en: She doesn't eat meat.
sentences.slip: She not eat meat.
sentences.note: Отрицание в настоящем времени всегда через don't/doesn't.

sentences.en: I do my best every time.
sentences.note: do my best — устойчивое «стараться изо всех сил».

sentences.en: Why don't you take a break?
sentences.note: «Why don't you…?» — вежливое предложение, а не упрёк.

sentences.en: Does this bus go to the old town?
sentences.ru: Этот автобус идёт в старый город?
sentences.prompt: ____ this bus go to the old town?
sentences.slip: Do this bus go to the old town?
sentences.note: Bus = it → Does.

sentences.en: The sunset yesterday was incredible.
sentences.note: Один закат → was.

sentences.en: We were at the beach all morning.
sentences.ru: Мы всё утро были на пляже.
sentences.prompt: We ____ at the beach all morning.
sentences.slip: We was at the beach all morning.
sentences.note: We/you/they → were. I/he/she/it → was.

sentences.en: I worked on the video until 3 a.m.
sentences.prompt: I ____ on the video until 3 a.m.
sentences.slip: I was work on the video until 3 a.m.
sentences.note: Правильный глагол в прошедшем: work + ed. Никакого was рядом.

sentences.en: Did you sleep well last night?
sentences.slip: Do you sleep well last night?
sentences.note: Вопрос о прошлом → Did + глагол в начальной форме.

sentences.en: I didn't finish the edit yesterday.
sentences.slip: I don't finish the edit yesterday.
sentences.note: Отрицание в прошедшем → didn't + начальная форма глагола.

sentences.en: She went to Bali in March.
sentences.ru: В марте она улетела на Бали.
sentences.note: go — неправильный глагол: go → went.

sentences.en: The coffee was cold when I came back.
sentences.prompt: The coffee ____ cold when I came back.
sentences.note: Coffee — единственное число → was.

sentences.en: Were you at the gym this morning?
sentences.prompt: ____ you at the gym this morning?
sentences.note: You всегда с were, даже про одного человека.

sentences.en: I ate scrambled eggs for breakfast.
sentences.note: eat → ate. Неправильный глагол, форму надо помнить.

sentences.en: They didn't come to the party.
sentences.slip: They not came to the party.
sentences.note: didn't + come, а не didn't + came.

sentences.en: My phone died during the call.
sentences.ru: Телефон сел прямо во время звонка.
sentences.note: die → died. Обычное правильное окончание -ed.

sentences.en: What did you cook this morning?
sentences.note: Вопрос о прошлом → did, и cook остаётся без окончания.

sentences.en: I think it will rain tomorrow.
sentences.note: После will глагол в начальной форме, без -s и без -ing.

sentences.en: He will run five kilometres tomorrow.
sentences.slip: He will runs five kilometres tomorrow.
sentences.note: Элиза спрашивала прямо: после will букву -s убираем.

sentences.en: I won't do anything this weekend.
sentences.ru: В эти выходные я ничего не буду делать.
sentences.note: will not → won't. Формы willn't не существует.

sentences.en: The phone is ringing. I will get it!
sentences.prompt: The phone is ringing. I ____ get it!
sentences.note: Решение прямо сейчас — всегда will.

sentences.en: I'll send you the file tonight.
sentences.note: I will → I'll в разговоре. Апостроф обязателен.

sentences.en: We won't play football in this rain.
sentences.ru: В такой дождь мы играть не будем.
sentences.prompt: We ____ play football in this rain.
sentences.note: won't + начальная форма глагола.

sentences.en: It will be cold in the mountains.
sentences.slip: It will cold in the mountains.
sentences.note: Перед прилагательным нужен be: will BE cold.

sentences.en: What will you do after work?
sentences.note: Порядок жёсткий: вопросительное слово + will + подлежащее.

sentences.en: I promise I will help you tomorrow.
sentences.note: Обещание — один из четырёх случаев will.

sentences.en: She will go to the concert on Friday.
sentences.ru: В пятницу она пойдёт на концерт.
sentences.prompt: She ____ to the concert on Friday.
sentences.note: will go — без -s, без -ing.

sentences.en: I wait for Alina every evening.
sentences.slip: I wait Alina every evening.
sentences.note: wait FOR somebody — предлог обязателен.

sentences.en: He attacked my opponent.
sentences.slip: He attacked for my opponent.
sentences.note: attack somebody — БЕЗ предлога. Твоя ошибка «attack for».

sentences.en: He told me about the new patch.
sentences.ru: Он рассказал мне про новый патч.
sentences.prompt: He told ____ me about the new patch.
sentences.slip: He told for me about the new patch.
sentences.note: tell somebody — без предлога. А вот say TO somebody — с предлогом.

sentences.en: I live in Cyprus.
sentences.slip: I live on Cyprus.
sentences.note: Страны и города — всегда in: in Cyprus, in Limassol.

sentences.en: The keys are on the table.
sentences.note: Поверхность → on. Внутри → in.

sentences.en: We met at the coffee shop.
sentences.note: Точка встречи → at. at the shop, at the airport, at home.

sentences.en: I go to the gym on Mondays.
sentences.ru: По понедельникам я хожу в зал.
sentences.prompt: I go ____ the gym on Mondays.
sentences.slip: I go in the gym on Mondays.
sentences.note: Движение куда-то → to.

sentences.en: This video is for my channel.
sentences.note: Здесь for на месте: «для кого-то, для чего-то».

sentences.en: The meeting starts at two o'clock.
sentences.note: Точное время → at. Дни → on. Месяцы → in.

sentences.en: I was born in September.
sentences.note: Месяцы и годы → in September, in 2026.

sentences.en: See you on Friday.
sentences.slip: See you in Friday.
sentences.note: Дни недели → on Monday, on Friday.

sentences.en: Thank you for your help.
sentences.note: thank somebody FOR something.

sentences.en: I listen to music while I edit.
sentences.ru: Я слушаю музыку во время монтажа.
sentences.prompt: I listen ____ music while I edit.
sentences.slip: I listen music while I edit.
sentences.note: listen TO music — предлог обязателен, в отличие от русского.

sentences.en: I'm looking for my charger.
sentences.note: look for = искать. look at = смотреть на.

sentences.en: I would like a salad, please.
sentences.note: Вежливая формула заказа. «I want» звучит как приказ.

sentences.en: Can we have the bill, please?
sentences.note: bill — счёт до оплаты. receipt — чек после.

sentences.en: I would like scrambled eggs, please.
sentences.slip: I would like scrambled, please.
sentences.note: scrambled — прилагательное, ему нужно существительное.

sentences.en: The waiter brought our food quickly.
sentences.note: waiter — мужчина, waitress — женщина.

sentences.en: What would you like to drink?
sentences.note: Вежливый вопрос официанта — would.

sentences.en: It was delicious, thank you.
sentences.note: Еда уже съедена, и она одна → was.

sentences.en: Today the chef's special is pizza.
sentences.note: chef's special — блюдо дня.

sentences.en: Could I have the menu, please?
sentences.note: После could идёт начальная форма глагола.

sentences.en: I'm allergic to nuts.
sentences.slip: I'm allergic for nuts.
sentences.note: allergic TO something — предлог именно to.

sentences.en: We booked a table for four people.
sentences.prompt: We booked a table ____ four people.
sentences.note: Здесь for правильный: «на четверых».

sentences.en: I treat sick people. I am a doctor.
sentences.prompt: I treat sick people. I am ____.
sentences.slip: I treat sick people. I am doctor.
sentences.note: Профессия всегда с артиклем: a doctor.

sentences.en: I catch criminals. I am a police officer.
sentences.slip: I catch criminals. I am police officer.
sentences.note: Ровно та фраза с урока, где Элиза пропустила ошибку.

sentences.en: I fly planes. I am a pilot.
sentences.note: a pilot — согласный звук, поэтому a.

sentences.en: I deliver letters. I am a postman.
sentences.note: postman разносит почту, delivery man возит заказы.

sentences.en: I cut men's hair. I am a barber.
sentences.prompt: I cut men's hair. I am ____.
sentences.slip: I can men's hair. I am barber.
sentences.note: cut hair — стричь. На уроке у тебя выпал глагол.

sentences.en: I work on a plane but I'm not a pilot.
sentences.ru: Я работаю в самолёте, но я не пилот.
sentences.prompt: I work on a plane but I'm ____.
sentences.slip: I work on a plane but I'm a not pilot.
sentences.note: Порядок жёсткий: I'm + not + a + профессия.

sentences.en: I travel to space. I am an astronaut.
sentences.ru: Я летаю в космос. Я космонавт.
sentences.prompt: I travel to space. I am ____.
sentences.note: Гласный звук в начале → an.

sentences.en: I bake bread. I am a baker.
sentences.note: baker печёт, chef готовит блюда.

sentences.en: What do you do for a living?
sentences.prompt: What ____ you do for a living?
sentences.note: «What do you do?» — самый частый вопрос о профессии.

sentences.en: I edit videos. I am a video editor.
sentences.slip: I edit videos. I am video editor.
sentences.note: Твоя собственная профессия — тем более с артиклем.

sentences.en: I saw Susie sitting in a shoe shine shop.
sentences.ru: Я видел Сюзи в мастерской чистки обуви.
sentences.prompt: I saw Susie sitting in a shoe shine ____.
sentences.note: Тренирует переключение между [s] и [ш].

sentences.en: Kitty caught the kitten in the kitchen.
sentences.prompt: Kitty caught the kitten in the ____.
sentences.note: kitchen — кухня, chicken — курица. Не путай.

sentences.en: A big black bear bit a big black bug.
sentences.prompt: A big black bear bit a big black ____.
sentences.note: bear — медведь [бэа], beer — пиво [биа].

sentences.en: We all scream for ice cream.
sentences.note: «I scream» и «ice cream» звучат почти одинаково.

sentences.en: How much wood would a woodchuck chuck?
sentences.prompt: How much wood would a ____ chuck?
sentences.note: Тренирует [w] и [у]: wood, would, could.

sentences.en: If a dog chews shoes, whose shoes does he choose?
sentences.ru: Если пёс жуёт ботинки, чьи он выберет?
sentences.prompt: If a dog chews shoes, ____ shoes does he choose?
sentences.note: whose — чей. who's — это who is.

sentences.en: Whether the weather is warm or cold, we go out.
sentences.ru: Тёплая погода или холодная — мы всё равно выходим.
sentences.prompt: Whether the ____ is warm or cold, we go out.
sentences.note: weather — погода, whether — «ли». Звучат одинаково.

sentences.en: Fuzzy Wuzzy was a bear.
sentences.note: bear рифмуется с hair, в этом вся соль.

sentences.en: I think of six thin things.
sentences.ru: Я думаю о шести тонких вещах.
sentences.note: Межзубный [θ]: кончик языка между зубами.

sentences.en: We surely shall see the sun shine soon.
sentences.prompt: We surely shall see the sun shine ____.
sentences.note: Тренирует [s] и [ш] вперемешку.

vocab.does: форма do для he / she / it
vocab.won't: will not — не буду, не будет
